expert.name: Riya
expert.quote: Three countries in ten days, and Luang Prabang is the one nobody expects to like most. It is the slowest, quietest town in the region.
expert.tip: Get up for the alms giving in Luang Prabang at dawn. Stand well back, buy nothing from the touts, and just watch.

summary: Ten days through three countries: two nights in Hanoi with Ninh Binh and a full day on Halong Bay, three on the river at Luang Prabang with the old royal town and an elephant camp day, then Siem Reap for Tonle Sap, Angkor and the sacred mountain at Phnom Kulen.
included: Included: 9 nights with breakfast daily and dinner at the Vietnamese and Cambodian hotels; all flights between the countries; private transfers throughout; a Ninh Binh day tour; a cycle ride to Bich Dong; a full day dragon boat cruise on Halong Bay; a Luang Prabang sightseeing tour; an elephant village and mahout day; a Tonle Sap lake boat ride; an Angkor Wat day tour; a Phnom Kulen day trip.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Vietnam, Laos and Cambodia visa fees; lunches; travel insurance; personal expenses.
